_comment: Hand-curated notes on observed atmospheres. Only planets with a published observation are listed; every other planet shows 'Atmosphere: not measured'. Each note cites its source.

K2-18 b.note: JWST detected methane (CH4) and carbon dioxide (CO2).
K2-18 b.source: Madhusudhan et al. 2023, The Astrophysical Journal Letters 956, L13

GJ 1214 b.note: Hazy, high-metallicity atmosphere inferred from JWST thermal phase curve.

LHS 3844 b.note: Spitzer thermal phase curve rules out a thick atmosphere; likely bare rock.

55 Cnc e.note: JWST thermal emission suggests a secondary atmosphere, possibly rich in CO or CO2.

HD 189733 b.note: JWST detected hydrogen sulfide (H2S), plus water and CO2.

WASP-39 b.note: JWST detected carbon dioxide (CO2) and sulfur dioxide (SO2, from photochemistry).
WASP-39 b.source: JWST Transiting Exoplanet Community ERS Team 2023, Nature 614, 649; Tsai et al. 2023, Nature 617, 483

WASP-121 b.note: Hubble found water emission from a stratosphere (temperature inversion).

KELT-9 b.note: Ground-based spectroscopy detected atomic iron and titanium vapour.
